segments.contextAfter: When a peer first becomes visible to the session, it appears with a state of GKPeerStateAvailable.  Your application should show this peer in its user interface. If the peer changes its state to GKPeerStateUnavailable, it no longer accepts connection requests and your application should remove it from the user interface.
